svg.title: parity-deriva · the simulation engine
svg.desc: One event bus, the same handlers, two wirings. Backtest: candles from the store, strategy, money manager, simulator and SimulatedBroker close the loop. Live: the broker's candles, execution and the real broker, with the simulator running as a shadow and the parity monitor comparing the two sides.
svg.text: one event bus · the same handlers run live and in a backtest · docs/ENGINE.md
one candle at a time: everything it causes is dispatched before the next one
when candle N is read, the book holds exactly the orders of candles 1 to N−1 · guard: 10 000 events per candle
one trade at a time · size
one thread per source (candles, transactions), one queue, heartbeat 0.5 s
right live: bars arrive minutes apart, so an order is resting long before the next bar
the simulator reports with its own
the money manager or the account
session closer, trade timer, progress (if asked)
a stop moved on a bar applies from the next bar;
resting order: its level, if inside low–high
gap over the level: fills at the open
stop already passed at the open: the open
several on one bar: nearest to the open first (OCO)
stop or target closes; CLOSETRADE at the close
buy on the ask, sell on the bid: the spread is in the prices
P/L = (exit − entry) × units · financing 0, no commission
No look-ahead · what a bar cannot say
a strategy acts on a closed bar; its order fills from the next
the trailer moves the stop for the next bar
two granularities are ordered by close time, never open time
live: first bar allowed is the one forming at start (notBefore)
stop and target in one bar: the bar cannot say which came first
backtest/resolution.py measures it: coarse vs fine bars
backtest/shadow.py fills on the finest bars in the store (M5)
fallback to a coarser series over 1 000 000 fine bars
EventSaver + EventReplay: a live session can be run again
the simulator: one behaviour, every comparison rests on it
STATUS (DONE · HALT · LIQUIDATE · RESUME): anyone to everyone
